description: ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS through the SQL surface: adding an already-present column is forgiven leaving the existing column and its TYPE untouched (case-insensitively, idempotently, in mixed sequences with the unforgiving form), works with qualified names, ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS (a missing table a clean no-op), data-bearing tables, complex and parameterized types. Converted 1:1 from features/AddColumnIfNotExistsTest (now retired).
